title: FunctionResponseFileData
description: URI based data for function response.

mimeType.description: The IANA standard MIME type of the source data. If an unsupported MIME type is provided, an error will be returned. For a complete list of supported types, see [Multimodal function responses](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/function-calling#multimodal) and [Supported file formats](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/file-input-methods#supported-content-types).

displayName.description: Optional. Display name of the file. Used to provide a label or filename to distinguish file data, and to reference the file from `FunctionResponse.response` (for example, via `{"$ref": "DISPLAY_NAME"}`).
